row.body: A fuel can is paired with a field-use note and a weapon listed as returned. The trailer’s key line remains open after the owner’s check-in ended.
row.title: A trailer return

sidecar.gloss: A field-use note and equipment return leave the trailer handoff incomplete.
sidecar.rival_reading: A containment detail could have returned equipment after a search; the open key line does not identify what the crew was tracking.
